notes.title: Version 1.0.6 already updated
notes.notes:
We have just updated version 1.0.6. This update won't affect the exist replay file.
This update will download the entire game content (486MB) because we reorganized the game files. Incremental updates will be more convenient in the future.

Update:

[olist]
[*] improve the text display of the Ending screen
[*] Staff screen supports fast-forward and skip
[*] add game data recovery,  and you can change the number of auto backup files
[*] fix the unlock condition of Last SpellCard in practice mode
[*] add German and French translation, and revise some text problems in Japanese and English
[*] preload some game resources to reduce the loading time when switching stages
[*] the replay file will stores the game version and can be viewed through the Replay screen
[*] try to fix the black screen problem (I hope it's really been fixed)
[*] Improve the efficiency of the game script
[*] update Steam SDK
[/olist]

Happy children's day!

notes.title: Version1.04 already updated.English and Japanese dialogue is now available
notes.notes:
We have deployed 1.04 update. The full game story is now available in English and Japanese. See below for details:

1.Optimized the dialogue in English and Japanese, and ending as well
2.Remade the dialogue bubbles to improve appearance
3.Fixed a bug in the practice mode to make sure all the options match the correspond stage

Please be advised that the translation is not complete yet. Due of technical issues, there are still translations to be deployed, like the names of spell cards and some Graphic UI.

Do you think English and Japanese support is all we've got? No, we have a bigger plan. The first draft of German translation is being proofread, the work on Polish translation is in progress (special thanks: Jan from Poland), and French translation is also being planned.

Since we lack the support of native speakers, we are looking for volunteers to improve our translation. You are also welcomed if you wish to add support to your language. Please contact: touhoueis@outlook.com

notes.title: Version1.03 already updated
MC幻想乡x东方祈华梦联动活动已经开启！
notes.notes:
东方祈华梦xMineCraft幻想乡联动活动已经开启！
受到破损樱玉的影响，幻想乡陷入了寂侘的异变之中，乡长需要在灵梦等人前往外界寻找另一半樱玉之时筹齐足够的修复材料——樱花瓣。通过采集、退治、跑酷等方式搜寻樱花瓣的下落，可以从樱华院静处兑换各种限定樱花武器、时装、技能、强化石～
凡是购买了《东方祈华梦》的玩家均可凭截图领取1000樱花瓣与专属技能“樱华院的祝福”，同时也正在开展画祈华梦同人送奖励的活动，相关细节敬请登陆MCG官网http://gensoukyo.moe/ 加入玩家群了解。
